title: 2024 Arizona historical outbreak baselines for Figure-3 timeliness evaluation
note: Pre-extracted by hand from the SQL seed because parsing the seed at runtime is fragile (string-typed dates with mixed precision). Re-derive whenever schema/deep/outbreaks.sql changes. The interval medians below are the 2024 counter-factual the Phase-3 plan/05-roadmap.md success criterion judges the agent pipeline against.

outbreaks.label: 2024 Arizona Hantavirus Spike
outbreaks.primary_geography: Apache, Coconino, Navajo, Maricopa, Pima counties

milestone_precision.detect: month-only (start_date '2024-01' in SQL; midpoint of January used)

outbreaks.reference: ADHS HAN advisory 2024-07-08; first Pima County HPS case ever recorded.

outbreaks.label: 2024 Arizona Record Heat Season

milestone_precision.detect: month-only (start_date '2024-04'; mid-April used as Detect proxy = first heat-attributable ED visit cluster of the season)
milestone_precision.notify: estimated (~5 days post-Detect; MCDPH heat surveillance typically declares season-onset within a week of the first cluster)
milestone_precision.public_comm: estimated (MCDPH heat dashboard published at same time as Respond)

outbreaks.reference: MCDPH 2024 Heat-Associated Deaths Report (Mar 2025); NWS Phoenix climate summaries.
